LESSON: BELIEF IN

Grade: PP2
Subject: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: PILLARS
Topic 2.1: Belief in

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello learner! Today we will learn about Belief in. Read carefully, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. identify oneself and Allah’s Creation Myself and others (Immediate environment: family members, neighbours, animals, plants) developmentally appropriate activities (Suggested time: 4 lessons) care of themselves, plants and pets nature walk in the school environment.

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Greet others politely using Islamic greetings you have learned.

Example 2: Keep yourself clean before prayer, just as you wash hands before eating.

Example 3: Share with a friend one good manner you practised today.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Read the examples above again. Underline two new words or ideas about Belief in.
2. Explain Belief in to a parent or classmate using your own words and one Kenyan example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Belief in.
4. Show that you can: identify oneself and Allah’s Creation Myself and others (Immediate environment: family members, neighbours, animals, plants) developmentally appropriate activities (Suggested time: 4 lessons) care of themselves, plants and pets nature walk in the school environment.
5. Complete the Work to do section, then attempt the Revision Quiz. Check Answers only after you finish.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Belief in. Use examples from your school, home, or market.
2. Answer this question in your exercise book: Why is Belief in important to you?
3. Make a short oral presentation (about one minute) to your parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 8: REMEMBER

1. identify oneself and Allah’s Creation Myself and others (Immediate environment: family members, neighbours, animals, plants) developmentally appropriate activities (Suggested time: 4 lessons) care of themselves, plants and pets nature walk in the school environment.
